color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · CURATE
you, in Zotero
Breadth is the whole job here.
A thin corpus shows up
immediately as a thin survey.
papers/bibliography.bib
the only source either skill can reach —
everything retrieval returns is citable

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENRICHMENT — worth it for this genre
chitragupta enrich --stages docling,embed
docling → layout-aware .md + .passages.json
better quotable passages, so claims survive review
embed → content/chroma/
semantic recall: finds the paper that argues the
point in different words. Both skills name
embed_index.search() by hand.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · DRAFT
every sentence is a cited claim
survey-writer — over-fetch k=15,
hand-cluster into 2-4 sub-themes,
comparison table + gap analysis
deep-research — perspectives,
parallel interviews, contradiction map,
then cited sections
content/drafts/<slug>.md

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · VERIFY
chitragupta draft gate
Highest citation density
in the repo, so this
is the genre where
the gate earns its keep

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
swap the key for one retrieval
actually returned, or drop the claim.
Never invent one.

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · PUBLISH
chitragupta draft references → IEEE list
chitragupta draft render --format tex
--format pdf · --format md
content/rendered/<slug>.pdf

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LAYER 4 · REVIEW — afterwards, never a gate
chitragupta review provenance · chitragupta review verbatim
chitragupta review coverage · chitragupta review synthesis
chitragupta review figure · chitragupta review uncited
chitragupta review quotation · chitragupta review agenda
chitragupta review support · chitragupta review union
“retrieval surfaced it — did the draft cite it?”
only meaningful when the corpus is the argument

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bertopic → content/topics.json
no skill calls this. It is for you, deciding what
the survey should even be about.

svg.text: Genre A — corpus-led writers: survey-writer, deep-research
